Xocai Chocolate Mousse
By: Xocai Chocolate
Published: Friday, November 9, 2012 - 10:11am

Ingredients




7-10 Xocai Healthy Chocolate Nuggets, melted (more or less to taste)
One 8 once tub of lite whipped topping, divided

Preparation

1 Melt Nuggets in fondue pot or over double boiler, Do not heat over 100 degrees. 2 Using spatula, spread approximately 2 tbsp of meted Nuggets in the bottom of a 3-quart mixing bowl. Add 1/2 cup of whipped topping and whisk together. Add remaining melted Nuggets and whisk until blended completely. Add remaining whipped topping and blend completely. Ingredients have to be blended in this way or Nuggets will harden in the whip topping and the consistency will be grainy. Serves 4 to 6

About

Xoçai is the worlds creator of truly HEALTHY Chocolate! You may be wondering if chocolate can really be healthy. The answer is an overwhelming “YES!” In fact, thousands of studies have shown that high-quality, antioxidant-rich chocolate can contribute to major health improvements. People across the globe have discovered that Xoçai Healthy Chocolate truly can make a difference in one’s health. Learn more here: www.xocai.com
